description: Authoritative Rehearsal 009 completion policy, written into the competition repository's ros.json at T0 by `r9.fsx govern` and checked unchanged by `r9.fsx check-governance` in its CI. No workTypes: Praxis then applies the policy to every work type, so no type (research, mechanical, ...) escapes it. The only exception is Praxis's own lifecycle records (praxis init/upgrade), which are not completed through `work complete`.
